items.title: Nvidia stock drops as board weighs Jensen Huang’s future
items.brief: The Nvidia board is meeting to discuss the future of embattled CEO Jensen Huang, two sources familiar with the matter told CNN.

items.title: Massive rescue effort underway after NYC building collapse leaves at least 1 dead, 12 injured, officials say
items.brief: Several people are dead, including at least one child, after a mixed-use three-story building in New York City collapsed Wednesday afternoon, a city official said.

items.title: Clinging to life and crying, a baby was found buried alive a day after his father took him, investigators say
items.brief: Trapped in a dog crate and entombed beneath a foot of dirt, a South Carolina infant miraculously survived 24 hours buried underground, authorities say.

items.title: Look out for fireballs as the Northern Taurid meteor shower reaches its peak
items.brief: Those who missed last week’s Southern Taurids meteor shower have another chance to watch a fireball blaze across the sky, as the Northern Taurids reach their peak.

items.title: First snow, coldest air in months headed for eastern US in wake of storm
items.brief: Winter will make its first cameo in the eastern United States this week as a storm ushers in the coldest temperatures in six months for tens of millions of people and the first snow for some.
